desc:
Short video editing for Reels and TikTok turns your raw clips into tight vertical videos that hold attention. Ecom Swift LLC cuts, captions and exports each one for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, in your style.

## Why raw footage rarely works as it is

Footage filmed on a phone usually has slow starts, pauses, background noise and no captions. Viewers decide within a moment whether to keep watching, and many watch with the sound off. A clip that opens with silence or a long introduction loses them before the point arrives.

Editing is where a rough recording becomes a watchable video. Cutting the slow parts, adding on-screen text and tightening the pacing helps a viewer understand the message without effort. It is also where your brand shows up, through consistent fonts, colors and a recognizable style.

## What is short video editing for Reels and TikTok?

Short video editing for Reels and TikTok is the process of turning filmed clips into brief, vertical videos made for feed-based channels. It covers trimming, ordering shots, pacing, captions, music or sound, branded text and exports in the right size and format for each platform.

## How edited video affects attention and action

Short video is one of the main ways new people discover a brand. A strong opening hook gives viewers a reason to stay, clear captions keep sound-off viewers engaged, and a closing line tells them what to do next, such as visit your shop or follow your page.

Edited video can lift watch time and make your products easier to understand, since people see them in use. We cannot promise views or sales, because reach depends on the channel, the idea and the audience. Good editing makes sure your footage gives the idea its best chance.

## What a great short video includes

- A hook in the first moments that makes a viewer stay.
- Cuts that remove pauses and repeated takes.
- Pacing that matches the mood and the music.
- Readable captions placed clear of platform buttons.
- Licensed music or sound from approved libraries.
- Branded text styling using your fonts and colors.
- A clear end line or screen with a single action.
- A cover image for the feed or profile grid.
- Exports sized for each channel, in vertical format.
- A saved caption style, so future videos look consistent.

## What we do

You send raw clips, along with the point of each video and any brand assets. We review the footage, choose the strongest takes, edit the sequence and add captions, sound and text. We then share a draft for feedback, apply changes within your included revisions and deliver final files.

The Basic package covers a few short videos with cuts, captions, licensed sound and a vertical export. The Standard package adds a hook opening, branded text, cover images and exports for three channels. The Premium package delivers a larger batch with a saved caption style, simple motion text, sound effects, end screens and a handover call. You can add more videos, subtitles in another language or a thumbnail set. We edit what you film and do not shoot new footage.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Film in vertical format with steady light and clear sound.
- Record a few extra seconds before and after each take.
- Tell us the one point each video must make.
- Keep a short list of music moods you like.
- Check the final video with sound off to confirm the captions work.

**Avoid:**
- Sending footage with copyrighted songs playing in the background.
- Asking for too many ideas in one video.
- Using logos or clips that belong to other brands.
- Posting at the wrong size and letting the platform crop it.
- Expecting editing to rescue footage that is too dark or silent.

## Who this is for

This service suits a store owner who films product demos but never has time to edit them. It suits a coach, chef or maker who talks to camera and needs captions and pacing added. It also suits a brand with a backlog of unused clips that could become a month of content.

If you are unsure what to film, tell us. We can suggest simple shots, though writing scripts and planning content are separate pieces of work.

## What we need from you

Send your raw video files through a shared folder or a transfer link, along with your logo, fonts and brand colors, and a short note about each video. We work from files, so we do not need your passwords. If you want us to publish directly, a team or editor role on your channels is enough.
